'''Liu Yingming''' ({{zh|s=刘应明|p=Liú Yìngmíng}}; 8 October 1940 – 15 July 2016) was a Chinese [[mathematician]]. He was an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS).

==Biography==
Liu graduated from [[Peking University]] in 1963, majoring in mathematics. He was assigned to [[Sichuan University]] after his graduation. His research field was [[topology]] and [[fuzzy mathematics]], mainly in the algebra problem of unclear topology, embedded theory and nonclear convex sets.<ref name=death>{{cite news|title=一生研究模糊学 做事一点不模糊|url=http://news.163.com/16/0716/05/BS2TC3IK00014AED.html|publisher= Netease|date=16 July 2016|access-date=14 October 2016|language=Chinese}}</ref> Liu was the deputy president of Sichuan University between 1989 and 2005.<ref>{{cite news|title=九三学社原副主席刘应明逝世 一生痴情模糊数学|url=http://www.china.com.cn/cppcc/2016-07/18/content_38903486.htm |publisher= China.com.cn |date=18 July 2016|access-date=14 October 2016|language=Chinese}}</ref> He was elected an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 1995. Liu joined [[Jiusan Society]] in 1995. He was the vice chairman of the central committee of Jiusan Society from 1997 to 2007.<ref>{{cite news|title=刘应明同志逝世|url=http://news.xinhuanet.com/politics/2016-07/20/c_1119251047.htm|publisher= Xinhua Agency |date=20 July 2016|access-date=14 October 2016|language=Chinese}}</ref>

Liu was diagnosed as [[leukemia]] in November 2015. He died on 15 July 2016 at the age of 75 in [[Chengdu]].<ref name=death/>
